verdict.rationale: The pack contains no evidence that a user can configure a payout or settlement schedule, or view a per-payout breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds. The closest items are adjacent, not this capability: multi-currency settlement into the Airwallex Wallet, outbound Transfers to suppliers, and standalone refunds. None of them documents payout scheduling or payout-level reconciliation.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
